profile.headline: Web Developer | Software Developer
profile.summary: Over 15 years of website development and management and a decade of analytics and marketing experience resulting in an in-depth knowledge of web standards and technologies as well as an ability to communicate with clients and customers to find the best solutions.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Building and upgrading websites for customers, maximizing SEO and SEM best practices for greatest reach, and implement e-mail, social media, and PPC marketing strategies.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Angular · React.js · User Experience (UX) · WordPress

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer - User Interface Developer
positions.description:
Developed the user interface (UI) for the Movia Analyst Workbench product and other
projects connecting them to ontological and relational databases with REST.
Ensured that code quality was maintained through pair-programming, code reviews,
and unit testing utilizing build pipelines.
Directed junior developer on project, providing feedback on his code and direction to
improve coding skills.
Met with project stakeholders to gather feedback on status of projects and present
latest developments.
Research and present findings for new recommended technology that the team
should adopt.
Implemented use of StorybookJS and Chromatic to UI team allowing the UI engineers
to create, test, and store reusable components across projects.
Mentored and integrated junior developer into complex project with tight deadlines,
seeing the project to its successful completion and continued funding.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · TypeScript · JavaScript · HTML 5 · SASS

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.locationName: Fort Collins, Colorado, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Developed applications according to project designs and standards
Used the latest versions of Vue and Angular to develop web applications
Build reusable components to facilitate later development
Utilized RESTful and GraphQL to populate applications with data
Assisted in design of web applications providing clear guidance for mobile and desktop
Participated in code reviews and code approval processes
Part of cross-functional team that translated the needs of the client to designs and technical solution
Attended planning project timelines and milestones to meet clients needs
Adapt and learn new technologies as needed
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · JavaScript Frameworks · HTML 5 · CSS3

positions.title: Senor Digital Solutions Specialist & Manager of IT
Product Development Manager
positions.description:
Maintain all company websites (summitsoft.com and macwareinc.com) utilizing Wordpress CMS and customizing themes and plugins developed in HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, Javascript, PHP, and SQL.
Drive traffic to e-commerce sites using SEM, SEO, PPC, and social media marketing.
Built and maintained companies web applications (logodesignstudionow.com, Logo Design Studio Pro Online) integrating the custom plugin and theme with payment and email APIs and expanding the customizations with smaller Javascript libraries (SVGToPNG.js, OpenType.js)
Designed new software with design documentation and Photoshop mock-ups.
Developed new and improved current software for both PC and Mac, working with teams of 3-6 programmers coding in C#, .Net, Objective-C, and Swift
Capture customer registration and usage data by integrating software and websites to email marketing through RESTful APIs
Analyze reports from Google Analytics, email marketing (Mailchimp, Send In Blue, and Constant Contact), shopping carts (FastSpring), and company databases (registration and licensing) to identify actionable data that can be used to improve websites, products, and find new opportunities
Manage customer service team in order to manage product issues and rebuild customer relation- ships
Assist in the planning, reporting, and technical implementation of marketing strategy for e-commerce sites
Promote products, company expertise, and customer service through social media

positions.title: Operations Team Supervisor
positions.description: Supervise team of customer service Skill Specialists guiding them to more effective coaching and team management. Manage a team of work at home and traditional customer service agents to higher quality service through call reviews and real time coaching. Assist in the development of reporting programs to facilitate the gathering of agent data for weekly agent coaching and targeting goals. Conduct interviews for customer service agents and call center support positions.

positions.title: Internet Sales and Marketing Associate
positions.description:
Help local clients inform and attract new customers to there business by creating websites for in accordance with current design standards
Designed mockups and wireframes in Photoshop for meetings with clients
Developed clients websites in HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, and JQuery
Validate and test new sites for cross-browser compatibility
Customized clients websites by creating themes and plugins developed in PHP and MySQL.
Utilize SEO and SEM best practices to maximize redesigns for greatest reach
Build and maintain relationships with current client’s customers through social media and email marketing
Drive new business to clients through SEM, social media, and PPC marketing
Educate and inform clients about the state of their online business with regular meetings and reports

positions.title: Marketing Director
positions.description: Conduct in home sales and marketing to consumers of K-Designer's widows and and siding.

positions.title: Sales Team Leader
positions.description:
Lead team of licensed insurance sales agents.Coach agents to reach marketing and sales goals, reviewing their progress on a regular basis. Monitor calls to provide feedback to agents on marketing and sales efforts. Address elevated customer issues. Develop new programs to improve agent and call center productivity.
Review current processes and procedures, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement to the director. Participate in interdepartmental teams to implement new technologies. Conduct interviews of agents moving from temporary to regular employment status in the call center. Work within budget to develop incentive programs on a yearly, monthly, and weekly basis.

positions.title: Team Supervisor
positions.description: Supervise and manage a team of 30+ sales and customer service agents, monitoring their short and long term progress. Provide weekly and monthly reports of agents’ development to management. Coach veteran and new hire agents to provide optimal service to customers. Mentor agents for other company opportunities. Enhance processes and applications in Traffic, Mail Operations, Scheduling, Customer Relations departments. Conduct interviews for various support positions and documentation when necessary. Assist Operations Managers in daily call center tasks. Handle and resolve elevated issues with customers. Monitor calls and service levels.
